limitations: WEB-01 implements the wide and compact desktop graph only. Search and filters are owned by WEB-02, the detail inspector by WEB-03, the narrow semantic tree by WEB-07, and the complete accessibility acceptance surface by WEB-08; their accepted-concept controls are intentionally not rendered as inert UI here.

DEL-07 still owns a committed OpenAPI snapshot, generated TypeScript client, and drift gate. WEB-01 treats the transport body as unknown and fails closed through a narrow runtime hierarchy normalizer rather than claiming generated-client parity.

The exact 5/12/36/43 inventory and 12/6/5/14/6 distribution are release assertions. An authoritative catalog version that intentionally changes those source counts must update this requirement and its evidence rather than silently changing layout output.

The connection witness runs only Node 24 built-ins and imports the pure production TypeScript modules directly, so reverting implementation cannot be confused with a missing package-manager cache or node_modules dependency.

Browser verification uses local FastAPI, the production Vite preview and proxy, and the exact Chromium revision managed by pinned Playwright at 1536 by 1024 and 1280 by 800. It does not claim the separately distributed Chrome channel, Firefox, WebKit, a production reverse proxy, mobile tree behavior, or live external providers.
